format_in: platform AI summary, Google Ads Advisor style (written)
slop_types: bold-label insight bullets with decorative glyphs (✦)
verdict headings ('is paying off', 'top performer', 'Wasted spend detected')
one-click [Apply] recommendations with an unexplained impact estimate
optimization score presented as a performance result
every claim stated with the same confidence regardless of the data behind it

planted_traps.where: 'Your target ROAS change ... drove a 12.3% increase in ROAS ... generating an additional $10,680'
planted_traps.why: a before/after on platform-reported ROAS is credited to one change; the change on Oct 2 also falls inside the comparison week and the bid strategy was still recalibrating

planted_traps.where: mobile cost per conversion 'increased for 3 consecutive days', Oct 9 to Oct 11
planted_traps.why: 3 days is noise, and the last 1-2 days are still filling in with lagged conversions
$12.40 against $14,620 of spend is not a finding

planted_traps.where: Performance Max 'outperforming' non-brand Search at 6.10 vs 2.85, and the budget shift
planted_traps.why: PMax ROAS includes brand searches and remarketing to past visitors, so it isn't comparable to non-brand Search; channel-level reporting is partial
no assumptions or method are given

expected_watchouts.where: tROAS change credited with the 12.3% ROAS increase and $10,680
expected_watchouts.why: attribution to a single change without a test; platform grading its own homework
below any minimum-days rule; recent days still settling

expected_watchouts.where: 'Set a -15% mobile bid adjustment' on a target ROAS account
expected_watchouts.why: Smart Bidding ignores device bid adjustments other than -100%, so the action would do nothing

expected_watchouts.where: PMax 6.10 vs Search 2.85 and the 20% budget shift
expected_watchouts.why: PMax mixes brand and remarketing traffic; compare against total account results or a holdout before moving budget
an estimate with no stated basis

cut_list: the $10,680 'additional conversion value' credited to the tROAS change
the mobile trend and the -15% mobile bid suggestion (kept only as '3 days of data')
the tablet 'wasted spend' finding and -100% suggestion (kept only as '$12.40 of spend')
the PMax budget shift and its +38 conversions estimate
the AI disclaimer and feedback widget
notes: Synthetic DTC skincare brand. The summary imitates the shape of a platform-written AI summary; it is not a copy of any real one. Numbers tie out: ROAS = value / cost (4.92 and 4.38), the 12.3% is 4.92 / 4.38, $10,680 = $71,890 - $61,210 (prior value not shown). The gold labels every figure platform-reported, keeps the tROAS claim attributed to Advisor rather than stated as fact, and shows what the device suggestions rest on instead of repeating them.
